purpose: Held-out base-model pass@k on a fresh exact-integer pack. This pack is not a training set.

decoder.parser: The last non-empty line must be exactly '####' followed by one integer.
decoder.chat_template: Required. A tokenizer without a chat template fails closed.

primary_metric: Fraction of tasks with at least one exact final line among k samples, with a Wilson 95% interval.

acceptance.stop_zero: pass_rate == 0. Do not retune and do not update.
acceptance.stop_saturated: pass_rate == 1. Do not retune the pack into a training set.
acceptance.nondegenerate_base_signal: 0 < pass_rate < 1. Authorizes only a separate update-cost smoke, not a policy-update comparison.

transformers.machine: One CUDA GPU. float16 on CUDA, including a T4; float32 otherwise.
transformers.sampling: do_sample=True, temperature=0.7; torch.manual_seed(seed) before each sample

excluded_sources: Prompts are generated from the seed above. They are not rows from GSM8K, SVAMP, ARC, MATH, OpenBookQA, StrategyQA, BoolQ, SNLI, DeepMath, or the retired inventory word-problem pilot.
update_comparison: scripts/heldout_exact_integer_update_comparison_v1.py exits 2. This protocol does not run best-of-n against GRPO or RFT.
does_not_establish: A pass or a failure is not a capability claim and is not evidence that an update helps. No model output is included in this protocol.
